units.source_text: 如今方知她生前不爱秋景的原因了。

en.t: Only now did he understand why she had not loved autumn scenery while she was alive.

units.source_text: 源氏虽已神志昏迷，还是反复阅读此信，不忍释手。

en.t: Although Genji was already dazed and confused, he read the letter again and again, unable to bear putting it down.

units.source_text: 他觉得知情识趣、可与谈心、能慰我情的人，现在只有这秋好皇后一人了。

en.t: He felt that the only person left who understood feeling and refinement, with whom he could speak from the heart and who could console him, was Empress Akikonomu alone.

units.source_text: 寻思了一会，哀思略略消减。

en.t: After pondering this for a while, his grief eased a little.

units.source_text: 然而眼泪淌个不住，频频举袖揩拭，不得闲暇。

en.t: Yet his tears kept flowing, and he had no respite from repeatedly raising his sleeve to wipe them away.
At last, with great difficulty, he took up his brush and wrote in reply:
